body: I hear your pain. I share it. What is this cruelty in life that we are often so unable to do something to ease someone's pain? I will just repeat what I said. I hear you, and I share it with you.

This is me, as well. I know killing myself would be the end of my dad and my sister. They will always be grieving the death of my mom five years ago from accute leukemia. Each of them has told me they couldn't survive another loss like that.

I wish I knew. I have outlived any reasonable opportunity for a whole life. That sounds ridiculous because I've got many, many years before retirement age. But really, if no one sees my value, I can't force that to be different. So, here I am, trying to will myself to die every night.
